hooks.command: node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const fp=d.tool_input?.file_path||'';const blocked=['appsettings.json','.env','secrets.json','credentials.json','.pem','.key'];const match=blocked.some(b=>fp.includes(b));if(match){console.error('[Hook] WARNING: Writing to sensitive file: '+fp);console.error('[Hook] Verify no secrets are being hardcoded.');process.exit(2)}process.exit(0)"

PreToolUse.description: Block writes to sensitive config files (appsettings.json, .env, secrets)

hooks.command: node -e "const d=JSON.parse(require('fs').readFileSync(0,'utf8'));const cmd=d.tool_input?.command||'';const dangerous=['git push --force','git reset --hard','rm -rf /','DROP TABLE','DELETE FROM WHERE 1=1'];if(dangerous.some(x=>cmd.includes(x))){console.error('[Hook] BLOCKED: Dangerous command: '+cmd.slice(0,100));process.exit(2)}process.exit(0)"
